summary:
[  edit  ]
The Over  TOP  places Input1 'over' Input2. The alpha of Input1 is used to determine what parts of the Input2 image are visible in the result.
Note:  This  TOP  supports 3D Textures and 2D Texture Arrays.

parameters.label: Fixed Layer
parameters.name: size
parameters.description: ⊞  - The selected input will become the fixed layer and the other input will be the overlay. This does not change the order of the composite (Input1 + Input2), only which layer is considered fixed and which layer is adjustable by the parameters on the Transform page. The resolution and aspect ratio of the Fixed Layer is used as the composite's final resolution and aspect ratio unless manually on the  Common Page

parameters.label: Pre-Fit Overlay
parameters.name: prefit
parameters.description: ⊞  - Determines how the Overlay layer (Overlay layer is the input that is NOT the Fixed Layer) fills the composite.

parameters.label: Fill
parameters.name: fill
parameters.description: Overlay layer is stretched/squashed to fill the resolution and aspect ratio of the Fixed Layer.

parameters.label: Fit Horizontal
parameters.name: fithorz
parameters.description: Overlay layer is stretched/squashed to fit the Fixed Layer horizontally.

parameters.label: Fit Vertical
parameters.name: fitvert
parameters.description: Overlay layer is stretched/squashed to fit the Fixed Layer vertically.

parameters.label: Fit Best
parameters.name: fitbest
parameters.description: Overlay layer is stretch/squashed to fit the Fixed Layer using the best possible match that does not crop any of the Overlay layer. The aspect ratio of the Overlay is maintained.

parameters.label: Fit Outside
parameters.name: fitoutside
parameters.description: Overlay layer is stretched squashed to fit the Fixed Layer using the worst possible match. This is the opposite of Best Fit. The aspect ratio of the Overlay is maintained.

parameters.label: Native  Resolution
parameters.name: nativeres
parameters.description: Overlay is not squashed or stretched. The Overlay layer uses its own resolution and aspect ratio during the composite. Pixel accurate composites require Native  Resolution , use this setting for to maintain an image's original resolution during the composite.

parameters.label: Justify Horizontal
parameters.name: justifyh
parameters.description: ⊞  - Specify the horizontal alignment of the Overlay.

parameters.label: Left
parameters.name: left
parameters.description: The Overlay is aligned to the left side of the Fixed Layer.

parameters.label: Center

parameters.description: The Overlay is centered in the Fixed Layer.

parameters.label: Right

parameters.label: Justify Vertical

parameters.name: extend
parameters.description: ⊞  - Sets the extend (or repeat) conditions of the Overlay layer. This parameter determines what happens at the edges of the Overlay layer.

parameters.label: Hold
parameters.name: hold
parameters.description: The pixel values at the edges of the Overlay layer continue to extend past that edge.

parameters.label: Zero
parameters.name: zero
parameters.description: The image does not extend past the edges of the Overlay.

parameters.label: Repeat
parameters.name: repeat
parameters.description: The image is repeated at the edges of the Overlay.

parameters.label: Mirror
parameters.name: mirror
parameters.description: The image is mirrored at the edges of the Overlay.

parameters.label: Rotate
parameters.name: r
parameters.description: Rotates the Overlay layer. Increasing values rotate clockwise, decreasing values rotate counter-clockwise.

parameters.label: Translate
parameters.name: t
parameters.description: ⊞  - Translates the Overlay layer in x and y.

parameters.label: Resolution  Menu
parameters.name: resmenu

parameters.label: Use Global Res Multiplier
parameters.name: resmult
parameters.description: Uses the Global  Resolution  Multiplier found in  Edit>Preferences>TOPs . This multiplies all the TOPs resolutions by the set amount. This is handy when working on computers with different hardware specifications. If a project is designed on a desktop workstation with lots of graphics memory, a user on a laptop with only 64MB VRAM can set the Global  Resolution  Multiplier to a value of half or quarter so it runs at an acceptable speed. By checking this checkbox on, this  TOP  is affected by the global multiplier.

parameters.label: Output Aspect
parameters.name: outputaspect
parameters.description: ⊞  - Sets the image aspect ratio allowing any textures to be viewed in any size. Watch for unexpected results when compositing TOPs with different aspect ratios. (You can define images with non-square pixels using xres, yres, aspectx, aspecty where xres/yres != aspectx/aspecty.)

parameters.label: Passes
parameters.name: npasses
parameters.description: Duplicates the operation of the  TOP  the specified number of times. Making this larger than 1 is essentially the same as taking the output from each pass, and passing it into the first input of the node and repeating the process. Other inputs and parameters remain the same for each pass.
